deploy.//: startCommand was 'python bot.py', which only worked while the service Root Directory was discord-bot/ (so bot.py sat at /app/bot.py). The root had to move to the repo root so the bot could import the repo-level mlb/ and core/ packages, and that broke this path — the container crash-looped on 'can't open file /app/bot.py'. start.sh is layout-agnostic: it finds bot.py at either /app/discord-bot/bot.py or /app/bot.py, and dispatches bot-vs-backend from SERVICE_ROLE / the Railway service name. This file overrides the root railway.toml, which is why that file's identical startCommand was not being used.
